detail.longDescription: Llama.cpp reaches 1.0.0 with more than 150 model architecture variants, alongside Llama apps for macOS and Windows. Future API and ABI incompatibilities require a major version bump for llama.cpp and ggml. Hardware backends compile as dynamic libraries loaded at runtime, separate from inference functions. https://www. developer-tech.com/news/llama- cpp-promises-stable-api-major-version-rules/ # Android # Hardware # AI # MachineLearning
